verdict.rationale: cubic's core product is automated PR review that runs on every PR without human intervention, including Ultrareview for risky changes, codebase scans that 'deploy thousands of AI agents' to scan whole repos, an Analytics API tracking 'how much AI code was authored' vs flagged/fixed, and auto-approval for compliant PRs — directly matching high-volume AI-authored PR verification. Community evidence corroborates real-world usefulness beyond basic LLM checks. Missing for 10: independent benchmarks quantifying review volume/throughput at scale, and third-party validation of auto-approval accuracy on agent-authored code.
